headline: Mood Tracker, from entry to detail
overview: Log your mood with emoji selection, date/time, and notes. View weekly trends to understand your emotional patterns over time.
targetAudience: Users interested in wellbeing tools for personal growth and self-discovery.

steps.title: Mood Tracker — Landing State
steps.description: The landing page showing the mood logging interface with emoji selector, date/time picker, and notes field.
steps.screenshotAlt: Mood Tracker landing page on desktop

keyFeatures: Log mood with intuitive emoji selection
Add date, time, and contextual notes to each entry
View weekly mood trends and patterns
Identify emotional triggers and cycles over time
tips: Log your mood at consistent times each day to build a reliable dataset.
Add notes about what happened before or during a mood to spot triggers over time.
note: Imported from Inner Quest's app-owned walkthrough library. The captures are real product evidence, but their original run manifest and detailed interaction log predate Walkthrough Studio, so freshness is not claimed.
